dialogues.speaker: Félix Yogue
dialogues.text: Salutations to you once again, Honorary Knight, would you like to try piecing the Evermotion Mechanical Painting together?

dialogues.speaker: Félix Yogue
dialogues.text: Hmm? It seems that you have some questions for me, yes?

dialogues.speaker: Félix Yogue
dialogues.text: Aha! Are you interested in the Daydream Club, by any chance?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Daydream Club? What is that?

dialogues.speaker: Félix Yogue
dialogues.text: Hmm, let me think, how should I explain this... So generally, a "club" is... a loose assembly of people sharing the same interests.

dialogues.speaker: Félix Yogue
dialogues.text: But... the Daydream Club is bound by something more than "interests" — that is to say, "dreams."

dialogues.speaker: Félix Yogue
dialogues.text: However, these "dreams" are often criticized as unrealistic. So we said to ourselves, "why not just name the club 'daydream'?" And that's what we did.

dialogues.speaker: Félix Yogue
dialogues.text: As for us, the members of the club are naturally "daydreamers" holding to our "daydreams."

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tell me more about the members of the Daydream Club...

dialogues.speaker: Félix Yogue
dialogues.text: Ah, we are not great in numbers, but our members are all extraordinarily imaginative.

dialogues.speaker: Félix Yogue
dialogues.text: I, Félix Yogue, wish to create an energy source that can operate in perpetuity!

dialogues.speaker: Félix Yogue
dialogues.text: And I want to use purely mechanical structures to build it, requiring no materials that regular people can't handle.

dialogues.speaker: Félix Yogue
dialogues.text: Next up is Xavier, the genius artist and creator of the Film Kamera — which, by the way, is an exquisite product, I'll tell you that.

dialogues.speaker: Félix Yogue
dialogues.text: However, his hidden talents are most stirringly displayed in the Films he creates.

dialogues.speaker: Félix Yogue
dialogues.text: We believe with all our hearts that this man will become the greatest Film Maker in Teyvat.

dialogues.speaker: Félix Yogue
dialogues.text: That said, I haven't heard from him since his journey to Inazuma. Honestly, what has he been doing?

dialogues.speaker: Félix Yogue
dialogues.text: Then there's another one of us — Mr. Garcia, who's working on a Numbering Machine.

dialogues.speaker: Félix Yogue
dialogues.text: Well, he does zone out from time to time... but trust me, he's a natural-born mathematical genius.

dialogues.speaker: Félix Yogue
dialogues.text: Last but surely not least, we have the brothers, Mécantre and Babisse, with their boundless energy.

dialogues.speaker: Félix Yogue
dialogues.text: They are working on a super-sized cannon. Their schematics state that it shall fire missiles that can fly high enough to touch the stars of Teyvat... all while carrying people inside.

dialogues.speaker: Félix Yogue
dialogues.text: They are still searching for the right fuel for the project, but their "daydream" is the craziest plan I've ever heard.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are you... serious?

dialogues.speaker: Félix Yogue
dialogues.text: Of course! We're absolutely serious about our "daydreams," haha! I mean, isn't "Daydream Club" a perfect name for us?

dialogues.speaker: Félix Yogue
dialogues.text: If you're interested, do visit the town of Petrichor in the Court of Fontaine. That's where our members gather.

dialogues.speaker: Félix Yogue
dialogues.text: That said, if you went there now, you'd probably encounter a rather downcast pair of brothers...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Um... I've actually met Xavier in Inazuma...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You tell Félix Yogue about your experiences with Xavier in Tatarasuna...

dialogues.speaker: Félix Yogue
dialogues.text: Ah, fabulous, fabulous! "Tatara Tales" shall make Xavier, bless his heart, famous overnight. Mark my words!

dialogues.speaker: Félix Yogue
dialogues.text: ...But honestly, I am just really relieved. I thought he might've, you know...

dialogues.speaker: Félix Yogue
dialogues.text: That said, since things have been dealt with, why hasn't he even sent one letter back...?

dialogues.speaker: Félix Yogue
dialogues.text: Whatever, I'll send a letter back to Petrichor later to tell Mécantre the news, so that he can stop worrying...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: See you.

dialogues.speaker: Félix Yogue
dialogues.text: Farewell. Once more, I salute you, Honorary Knight.
